title: AI Buildout is Boom 'Not Bubble,' Says Jared Gross
text:
Credit markets are again becoming jittery over the prospects of more mega debt deals hitting a market already flush with financings to pay for the AI arms race.
Jared Gross, Head of Institutional Portfolio Strategy at JPMorgan Asset Management, discusses AI asset allocation and why he believes the AI buildout is indeed a boom, not a bubble. (Source: Bloomberg)
